03_cues/cues.md ## receipt.share: AS MUCH AS sits UNDER the 80% readout, so the gauge reads top down as '80% / AS MUCH AS / OF SEVERE STORM CLAIMS / IN A YEAR ARE HAIL'. Fix: put AS MUCH AS ABOVE the readout and show it from the first frame of the count, so it reads 'AS MUCH AS / 80% / OF SEVERE STORM CLAIMS / IN A YEAR ARE HAIL'. Base (severe storm claims) and period (in a year, for 'in any given year') are fair as written, since the quote card just before carries 'severe convective storm' and 'in any given year' in full.
